title: Unlock Primal Invocation Quintessence
zone: Auction House and your character’s inventory

nodes.text: Review live Auction House listings for Primal Invocation Extracts. Choose eighteen rank 3, twenty-six rank 2, fifty-one rank 1, or seventeen rank 3 plus one rank 1/rank 2. Mixed qualities also work toward 2,600 points. Collect purchases from your mailbox, then continue when prepared. Skip this purchase review if you already began the same-character progress.
nodes.writtenDestination: Stormwind Trader’s Hall auction service (Alliance) or Orgrimmar Valley of Strength auction service (Horde); any observed accessible Auction House is valid.

recovery.text: Listing stock and prices are unknown until inspected. Existing partial progress may reduce what is needed, but unobserved past uses are not invented.

details.destinationPolicy: This preparation review is manual because extract consumption must not repeatedly reopen an inventory purchase threshold. Continuing only moves the guide cursor; it does not record a purchase or points.
details.mixedChoice: 17 rank 3 plus 1 rank 1 or rank 2. Other mixtures reach the same 2,600-point threshold.

nodes.text: Use an extract yourself on this same character whenever its actual one-hour cooldown is ready. Rank 1 adds 51 points, rank 2 adds 100 and rank 3 adds 150 toward 2,600. The buff can expire between uses. Return on later readiness periods until the toy item appears; a use never establishes toy ownership.

details.timing: One-hour elapsed cooldown. Initial remaining time is unknown until observed. Keep all progress on the same character.
details.destinationPolicy: Use the item from the assigned character’s inventory. Its cooldown does not create an expiring deadline.

recovery.text: If the preferred rank is absent, use another held rank manually. Unknown prior progress stays unknown; continue until actual toy receipt, and defer this activity while cooling down.

nodes.text: Use the received Primal Invocation Quintessence yourself and wait for the Toy Box ownership update.

recovery.text: Extract use, toy receipt and learning remain separate. Check inventory if the item has not yet appeared.
